title: Overview engine rows at 80x24: pad the kind column only when needed; no repeated state word; stopped age placement

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S33 UI pass (r14) findings not taken. (a) MUST: running engine rows pad to the 19-column started-elsewhere kind even when no external row is present, and lead with the 24-character run id, so at 80x24 the state word, steps and the S07 stage bar are cut (testdata/golden/engine-implement-80x24.txt:7, live-detail-80x24-mono.txt:7, engine-denials-100x30.txt). (b) On Needs rows the state word repeats the kind ('x stopped ... S22  stopped'). (c) The stopped age sits last in the row and is cut at 80 and 100 columns, shown only on the detail line. (d) Stopped rows still say 'N of M steps running' (pre-existing). Open for the owner: adj 149 (grouped, S84) will reshape these rows, so this slice should be small and S84 may supersede parts.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/overview.go` (engine row builder, kindW pad, the rest-cell order): pad the Running kind only when the Running section holds a started-elsewhere row; leave r.State out of the rest on rows that carry a kind; put the stopped age right after the slice; say nothing about running steps for a stopped run.
- `internal/tui/engine_runs_test.go`, `tui_test.go`, `testdata/golden/engine-*.txt`, `live-detail-*.txt`; `docs/dashboard.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestRunningEngineRowsPadOnlyWhenAnExternalRowExists: with no started-elsewhere row the kind column is not padded.
- TestEngineRowKeepsStateWordAndBarAt80x24: the state word and the stage bar survive at 80x24 for a running engine run.
- TestNeedsRowDoesNotRepeatTheStateWord.
- TestStoppedAgeSitsRightAfterTheSliceAndSurvivesAt100Columns.
- TestStoppedRowDoesNotSayStepsRunning.
- Golden views at 80x24 and 100x30.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Tests first. 2. Make the four row changes in overview.go. 3. go test ./internal/tui -update, review the golden diff. 4. Update docs/dashboard.md. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Decided by S33 owner answers: the kind column on engine Needs rows is kept; S84 reshapes later.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/tui
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
